text:
rachel: Postmortem follow-up for customer Aureus (dedicated). Root cause: on-prem peering flaps + short ephemeral port range -> conntrack exhaustion -> pod isolation. Dropping action items here.

omar: i'll own conntrack tunables and a temporary autoscale for the session-proxy. will prototype sysctl changes.

lee: i'll own peering hardening: increase BGP hold-time, add targeted route-flap damping, and add prefix stability checks into peering validation pipeline.

sana: i'll run the staging canary and produce the test runbook. plan: reproduce nightly batch spike (2k flows for 5m) and verify mitigation.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-90421 created and linked. Watchers: rachel, omar, lee, sana.

rachel: ACTIONS:
- A1 | Owner: omar | Due: 2026-04-06 | Increase conntrack_max and widen ephemeral ports; add autoscale for session-proxy | Status: open
- A2 | Owner: lee | Due: 2026-03-31 | Apply BGP hold-time=240s and route-flap damping for customer peer; update infra-configs | Status: open
- A3 | Owner: sana | Due: 2026-04-09 | Staging canary (2x/5x spike runs) + results | Status: todo
- A4 | Owner: rachel | Due: 2026-03-30 | Add detection: long-lived non-KA sessions >120s and rapid prefix-change alert | Status: in progress

omar: prototype snippet:
``
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=450000
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 61000"
```

lee: will keep damping scoped to that ASN/prefix set. will add rollback notes.

sana: scheduling canary next Tue in staging, will post results.

rachel: daily 09:00 PT sync until closed. post short updates here.

ops-bot: Daily standup scheduled 2026-03-26 to 2026-04-10 at 09:00 PT.
